items.title: Experimental Liverpool down Wrexham thanks to Rio Ngumoha’s deflected strike
items.summary: Substitute’s 75th-minute shot gives Liverpool 1-0 win in New York Chances few and far between in pre-season friendly that fails to ignite Liverpool turned the Empire State Building red when launching a new away kit on Tuesday but neither they nor Wrexham could illuminate Yankee Stadium 24 hours late
